name: Firmware Extraction
description: End-to-end firmware extraction from embedded devices, covering the full range from non-invasive debug interface access through advanced invasive techniques. The service template includes all potential SOP phases — PCB investigation, debug interface exploitation, chip-off dumping, firmware reverse engineering, and readout protection bypass via fault injection or FIB circuit editing. Projects should remove competencies not required for the specific target.
scope_reference: Firmware extraction and readout protection bypass for embedded devices
